# Missing Configuration File Error

The function read_config raises a CompileError if the expected configuration file (kc.toml) is not found in the specified repository directory. This introduces a risk of process failure if the configuration is not set up correctly.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
